title: Restricted report on Hawkins sighting
description:
RESTRICTED
CHECK-LIST - UNIDENTIFIED FLYING OBJECTS
Incident # 76


Date        13 Aug 47


Location    Salmon Dam


Name of observer        County Commissioner Hawkins
J. H. Brown


Place of observation    Salmon Dam


Number of objects       2


Distance of object from observer    [illegible] several miles away


Altitude    4,000 to 6,000 ft


Speed       great speed


Sound       echo of a motor - County Commissioner Hawkins
roar -- J. H. Brown


Color       N/S - reflected light


Shape       circular


Sketches or photographs    None


Remarks:    (over)


RESTRICTED
RESTRICTED
Agent could not locate Commissioner L. W. Hawkins but J. H. Brown, who accompanied Hawkins at the time stated that he and Hawkins could hear a roar.  They looked up and saw 2 objects flying at great height which might have been between 4,000 and 6,000 ft.  He could give no estimate as to size and said they could have been several miles away.  He and Hawkins were satisfied that [illegible] had seen something and were very doubtful if the objects were planes.
From a newspaper account (Times News, Twin Falls, Idaho, Friday Aug 15, 1947)
County Commissioner Hawkins said he had seen an unusual object in the air the same day as Urie' experience (Incident 75) and that a sound resembling the echo of a motor caused him to look upward and there he saw two circular objects which reflected light.  They were traveling at a great speed and at higher altitude than most planes.
RESTRICTED
